name: swamp-watch
description: Status line, pane and toasts for swamp workflow runs in the current repo and a swamp serve server

swampPath.title: swamp binary
swampPath.description: Path to the swamp CLI, or its name on PATH

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to re-read workflow runs; 30 at least

server.title: swamp serve URL
server.description: A swamp serve server to watch as well, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9090; empty to watch only the local repo

serverTokenFile.title: Server token file
serverTokenFile.description: Path to a file holding the server token; empty to use the credentials from swamp auth server-login
